items.title: 3.4.1 Rational Equations Reducible to the Quadratic Equation (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum un equations ko hal karenge jin mein variable fraction ke neeche, yani denominator mein hota hai. Pehli nazar mein yeh quadratic nahin lagtin, lekin ek hi qadam, LCD se multiply karna, inhein seedhi quadratic equation bana deta hai. Aap ne fractions jama karna aur LCD nikaalna pehle seekha hai; aaj wohi hunar kaam aayega.
Kitab ki definition: rational equation woh equation hai jis mein ek ya zyada rational expressions hon, aur aam taur par in rational expressions ke denominator mein variable hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Rational expression ka matlab hai aisa fraction jis ka numerator (ooper wala) aur denominator (neeche wala) dono polynomials hon, jaise \(\frac{1}{x}\), \(\frac{2}{x+1}\) ya \(\frac{x+1}{x-1}\). Lafz "rational" yahan "ratio" (nisbat) se aaya hai, yani ek cheez ko doosri se divide karna.
Ab ek bohat zaroori baat: zero se divide karna defined nahin hai. Misal ke taur par \(\frac{5}{0}\) ka koi matlab nahin. Is liye \(x\) ki har woh value jo kisi denominator ko zero kar de, shuru se hi mana (excluded) hai. Isi liye kitab equation ke saath \(x \ne 0, x \ne -1\) jaisi sharait likhti hai: yeh values kabhi bhi jawab nahin ban saktin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Rational equation hal karne ka tareeqa, qadam ba qadam:
1. Excluded values likhein (jahan denominator \(= 0\) ho).
2. Saare denominators ka LCD nikaalein.
3. Dono sides ke HAR term ko LCD se multiply karein; fractions ghayab ho jayenge.
4. Brackets kholein, saare terms ek taraf layein aur \(ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\) banayein.
5. Hal karein (factorisation ya quadratic formula).
6. Jo root excluded value ho use reject karein, aur baqi roots asal equation mein check karein.
Yeh tareeqa bilkul aisa hai jaise fractions wale hisaab mein hum sab ko common denominator par le aate hain, bas yahan hum denominator ko poori tarah hata dete hain.
Ab kitab ki misaal mein yeh tareeqa chala kar dekhte hain.

blocks.title: Example 7
steps:
Given: \(\dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{2}{x+1} = 1\), aur sharait \(x \ne 0\), \(x \ne -1\).
To find: \(x\) ki woh tamaam values jo equation ko satisfy karein (solution set).
Method: sab se pehle dekhte hain ke equation ki shakal kya hai. Variable do denominators mein baitha hai, is liye yeh rational equation hai. Plan: dono sides ko LCD \(x(x+1)\) se multiply kar ke fractions khatam karenge, phir \(ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\) banayenge, phir quadratic formula lagayenge. Aur aakhir mein restrictions aur check.

Step 1: LCD nikaalein
Denominators \(x\) aur \(x + 1\) hain. In mein koi common factor nahin, is liye
\[\text{LCD} = x(x+1)\]
Kyun: LCD (sab se chhota common denominator) se multiply karne se saare denominators ek hi waar mein khatam ho jate hain. Aur kyun ke \(x \ne 0\) aur \(x \ne -1\) diya hua hai, LCD zero nahin hai, is liye is se multiply karna jaiz hai. Zero se multiply karte to har equation \(0 = 0\) ban jati, koi faida nahin.

Step 2: Dono sides ko \(x(x+1)\) se multiply karein
\[x(x+1)\cdot\dfrac{1}{x} = x + 1\]
\[x(x+1)\cdot\dfrac{2}{x+1} = 2x\]
\[x(x+1)\cdot 1 = x(x+1)\]
To equation yeh ban gayi:
\[(x+1) + 2x = x(x+1)\]
Kyun: har fraction ka apna denominator cancel ho jata hai: pehle mein \(x\) kat gaya, doosre mein \(x + 1\) kat gaya.
Dhyan dein: right side wala 1 bhi multiply hoga! Bohat se bache sirf fractions ko multiply karte hain aur 1 ko waise hi chhor dete hain. Rule yeh hai ke dono sides ke HAR term ko multiply karna hai.

Step 3: Brackets kholein aur simplify karein
\[x + 1 + 2x = x^{2} + x\]
\[3x + 1 = x^{2} + x\]
Kyun: brackets khol kar har side par milte julte terms (like terms) jama kar diye: \(x + 2x = 3x\).

Step 4: Standard form mein likhein
\[x^{2} + x - 3x - 1 = 0\]
\[x^{2} - 2x - 1 = 0\]
Yahan \(a = 1\), \(b = -2\), \(c = -1\).
Kyun: quadratic formula tabhi lagta hai jab equation \(ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\) ki shakal mein ho. Humne \(3x + 1\) ko right side par le ja kar sab kuch ek taraf kar diya. \(a, b, c\) ko unke signs ke saath likhna zaroori hai; \(b = -2\) hai, sirf 2 nahin.

Step 5: Quadratic formula lagayein
\[b^{2} - 4ac = (-2)^{2} - 4(1)(-1)\]
\[= 4 + 4 = 8\]
\[x = \dfrac{-(-2) \pm \sqrt{8}}{2(1)}\]
\[x = \dfrac{2 \pm \sqrt{8}}{2}\]
Kyun: discriminant 8 perfect square nahin hai (4 aur 9 ke beech hai), is liye \(x^{2} - 2x - 1\) poore numbers mein factorise nahin hota. Aisi soorat mein quadratic formula hamesha kaam karta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-4(1)(-1) = +4\) hai; do minus milkar plus bante hain. Yahan sign ki ghalti bohat aam hai.

Step 6: Surd ko simplify karein
\[\sqrt{8} = \sqrt{4 \cdot 2} = 2\sqrt{2}\]
\[x = \dfrac{2 \pm 2\sqrt{2}}{2}\]
\[x = 1 \pm \sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: root ke andar se perfect square 4 bahar nikaala (\(\sqrt{4} = 2\)), phir numerator ke DONO terms ko 2 se divide kiya. Sirf pehle term ko divide karna aam ghalti hai.

Step 7: Restrictions se milayein
\(1 + \sqrt{2} \approx 2.414\) aur \(1 - \sqrt{2} \approx -0.414\). In mein se koi bhi \(0\) ya \(-1\) nahin, is liye dono qabool hain.
Kyun: agar koi value kisi denominator ko zero kar deti to use reject karna parta, chahe woh quadratic se hi kyun na nikli ho. Is misaal mein aisa nahin hua, lekin yeh check har dafa zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq:
Ab dono values asal equation mein rakh kar dekhte hain (har fraction ko rationalise kiya, yani denominator se root hataya).
\(x = 1 + \sqrt{2}\) ke liye:
\[\dfrac{1}{1+\sqrt{2}} = \sqrt{2} - 1\]
\[\dfrac{2}{2+\sqrt{2}} = 2 - \sqrt{2}\]
\[(\sqrt{2} - 1) + (2 - \sqrt{2}) = 1\]
\(x = 1 - \sqrt{2}\) ke liye:
\[\dfrac{1}{1-\sqrt{2}} = -1 - \sqrt{2}\]
\[\dfrac{2}{2-\sqrt{2}} = 2 + \sqrt{2}\]
\[(-1 - \sqrt{2}) + (2 + \sqrt{2}) = 1\]
Dono dafa \(\sqrt{2}\) aapas mein kat gaya aur jawab 1 aaya. Matlab dono values sahi hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari apni misaal hai (kitab ka sawal nahin), step 6 ki ahmiyat dikhane ke liye: \(\frac{x^{2}}{x-2} = \frac{4}{x-2}\), sharat \(x \ne 2\).
Dono sides ko \(x - 2\) se multiply karein: \(x^{2} = 4\), to \(x = 2\) ya \(x = -2\).
Lekin \(x = 2\) rakhein to denominator \(2 - 2 = 0\) ban jata hai, yani fraction be-maani. Is liye \(x = 2\) reject. Solution set \(= \{-2\}\).
Dekha? Quadratic ne do numbers diye, lekin asal equation ka hal sirf ek hai. Agar aap restriction na dekhte to ghalat jawab de dete.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(x + \frac{6}{x} = 5\), \(x \ne 0\) ko quadratic banane ke liye kis se multiply karenge, aur kaun si equation banegi? (Jawab: \(x\) se multiply karein, \(x^{2} + 6 = 5x\), yani \(x^{2} - 5x + 6 = 0\), jis se \(x = 2\) ya \(x = 3\). Dono mein se koi zero nahin, is liye dono qabool.)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Jawab ki shuruat restrictions likh kar karein (jaise \(x \ne 0, x \ne -1\)) aur aakhir mein "Solution set \(= \{\dots\}\)" likhein. Examiner dono cheezein dhoondta hai. Agar discriminant perfect square na ho (jaise 8, 12, 20), to factorise karne mein waqt zaya na karein; seedha quadratic formula lagayein.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Rational equation mein variable denominator mein hota hai.
2. Jo values denominator ko zero karein woh shuru se hi bahar (excluded) hain.
3. Dono sides ko LCD se multiply karne se equation quadratic ban jati hai.
4. Quadratic hal karein, phir excluded values reject karein aur asal equation mein check karein.
5. Example 7 ka jawab: \(\{1 \pm \sqrt{2}\}\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sirf fractions ko LCD se multiply karna aur poore number wale term (jaise Example 7 mein right side ka 1) ko bhool jana. Bachne ka tareeqa: multiply karne se pehle har term ke neeche ungli rakh kar ginein.
2. \(b^{2} - 4ac\) mein sign ki ghalti: \(-4(1)(-1) = +4\) hai, \(-4\) nahin.
3. \(\frac{2 \pm 2\sqrt{2}}{2}\) mein sirf pehle term ko 2 se divide karna; dono terms divide honge, jawab \(1 \pm \sqrt{2}\).
4. Aisa root rakh lena jo denominator ko zero kar de.
